Three-legged user access tokens can be revoked; static developer credentials support the app owner's single-account use. No refresh-token flow is asserted.

General callback docs allow local loopback and require exact registration. OAuth 1 app permissions are read/read-write, not OAuth 2 scope strings. Registered Ads app compatibility is untested; browser OAuth belongs to O2.

sources.quote: Include draft campaigns results in your request.
sources.fact: v12 GET accounts and accounts/:account_id/campaigns support count/cursor. with_draft=true includes drafts. Campaign response exposes entity_status and currency. Request account echo binds the campaign page.

v12 GET stats/accounts/:account_id: seven days maximum, twenty IDs, whole hours, TOTAL, one placement. ACCOUNT supports ENGAGEMENT impressions; BILLING and clicks are unsupported at ACCOUNT level and are projected as null. CAMPAIGN supports ENGAGEMENT/BILLING impressions, clicks and billed_charge_local_micro. Supported metrics may be null. Response contains time_series_length, id_data and echoed params. R1 supports ACCOUNT/CAMPAIGN and three documented placements only; no cross-entity or placement totals are inferred.

sources.quote: utilize the ad account level rate limit
sources.fact: Account rate headers take precedence over user headers. Synchronous analytics: 250 per 15 minutes. Global account reads: five per 15 minutes. Plugin returns pacing integers and stops on 429; no retry engine.
